title: Opening or refocusing Find cancels pending navigation without selecting a result
outcome: Opening an empty Find or refocusing it preserves in-flight End/tail navigation and reader restores; only actual search selection takes viewport authority. Ctrl+F uses the current pane/tab closure.
acceptance: Opening empty Find or refocusing it does not abort pending tail navigation, minimap seeking, or reader restoration; query edits and Next/Previous still supersede older navigation.
Ctrl+F after a tab switch uses the current scrollStateKey; regression coverage verifies the authority boundary.
